definitions.scope: Per-scale appendix uses strong original Reader heads (>0.3 in both banks), complete reference-distance concentration cohort700. No all14-scale averaged-per-distance trace90 rank or directional-lowfrequency summary found.
definitions.mean_matrix: Existing frame mean_matrix is positive spectral part of sym(uniform mean_D C_D); not mean_D Hplus(D), and not mean_D of rank90.
definitions.mean_Hplus: Single90M original7Reader compositions: eigendecompose uniform mean_D Hplus(D), all2048D. Separate mean_per_distance_trace90_rank computed from immutable cached eigenvalues; no forward calls or matrix recomputation.
definitions.fixedtopk_lowfreq: Single90MCSV perD Q/KOV shares use perD top-k positiveeigenvectors, k FIXED to trace90rank of mean_D Hplus. These means are not adaptive perDtrace90lowfreq and not trace-weighted directional plane amplitude.
definitions.bank_successor_score: For each bank, average attention probability at query q,key q-127 over q=128..254 (127queries), then average32independent repeatedrandomsequences. Each prefix128iidvocabularyIDs repeated verbatim, total256tokens. Fraction of attention to single correct successor key; not success rate or sum over candidates.
definitions.bank_formula: S_b=(1/(32*127))*sum_j=1..32 sum_q=128..254 attention_b,j[q,q-127]. strength=min(S_discovery,S_confirmation); eligibility originalReaderlabel1 and strength>tau strictly.
definitions.energy_formula: E_X,s=(1/|M_s|)*sum_m in M_s [(1/|H_m|)*sum_h in H_m [(1/2048)*sum_D=0..2047 ||X_mh(D)||F²]], F_X,s=E_X,s/E_C,s. M_s eligible included models with at leastonequalifyinghead; H_m originalReadersabovebothbankthreshold, frozenpairedhead.
definitions.geometry_formula: g_s=(1/|M_s|)*sum_m [(1/|H_m|)*sum_h g_mh]; rankmedian is median over model-wise headmean ranks. Frames separately, no crossdistanceaverage.
definitions.checkpoint_rule: Latest exact step shared by all25recipes and3selectedseeds within eachscale, pinned manifest; NOT globallylatestcheckpoint. Different scales use different trainingbudgets.
